content:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — finalizing ramp-to-GA acceptance heuristics. Need to lock SLA numbers, docs owner, monitoring alerts, pricing gate. Who can take SLA doc + runbook?

Samir Khan: I can draft SLA/SLOs. Thinking:
```
Hosted API: p99 latency <= 300ms, availability >= 99.9%
Dedicated: p99 <= 200ms, availability >= 99.95%
Error budget calc: monthly tokens * error rate
```
Need review from eng-runtime on measurement.

Liam O'Connor: +1 on draft. Two asks: define degradation policy (fallback models / degraded throughput) and explicit cold-start SLOs for private installs.

Harper Lee: I'll own public docs + quickstart. Need the canonical cURL examples, and an 'if X fails then Y' section for customers.

Ana Gomez: Support handback: we need runbooks for the top 5 failure modes. I'll pair with Samir to make runbook templates (pager steps, mitigation, postmortem checklist).

Maya Patel: Ownership noted: Samir (SLA + runbook), Harper (docs), Ana (support runbooks). Liam to finalize fallback policy. Deadline: EOD Friday — is that realistic?

Samir Khan: EOD Fri ok for first pass. Also proposing pricing gate: unit-cost delta < 20% vs current baseline for typical web-chat workload. @finance to sanity-check.

ops-bot: smoke-tests-schedule — nightly smoke runs added to CI for GA branch (tests: latency/p99, basic auth, model fallback). :robot_face: 

Harper Lee: Will add docs checklist: quickstart, troubleshooting, SLOs, billing examples, migration notes. Will ping @legal for privacy blurb.

Maya Patel: Risk triage: two 'escape hatches' — 1) soft GA without dedicated guarantees (hosted-only) 2) delayed pricing roll for enterprise customers. We should document triggers. Liam, can you draft the fallback SLA language for the escape hatch?

Liam O'Connor: On it. I'll drop a PR with precise wording and examples for degraded mode. ETA Thu morning.

Maya Patel: Great. I'll consolidate owners and open a single PR that links SLA + runbook + docs + smoke test matrix. Thanks all :raised_hands:
